gap.title: Host Identity (Systems/1) DRIFT
gap.summary: Two sub-issues: **a) HostName truncated** — `Systems/1.HostName` is `welktxwr-1372466-rh-le0140x-` (missing `-001`). The iLO hostname (`welktxwr-1372466-rh-le0140x-001`) is correct; only the host-side `Systems/1` field is truncated. This may indicate a 30-character limit in the Systems/1 HostName field on iLO 7 v1.20.00 (the full name is 32 characters). Investigate whether this is an iLO7 field limit or a prior provisioning error. **b) FQDN domain mismatch** — FQDN is `faredge.vzwops.com` but the provisioning standard uses `vcpfe.vzwops.com`. This server may have been provisioned with a site-specific config or before the DNS domain was standardized. Confirm which domain is correct for this unit before re-running.
gap.action: Re-run `el140_configure.py` (without `--check-only`) after confirming the correct DNS domain. Pass `--dns-domain faredge.vzwops.com` if the faredge domain is correct for this site.

redfish_catalog.name: aggregate_health_status
commands:
ssh vcpe-jumpserver "curl -gsk -u Administrator:XXXXXXXXXX -X GET \
  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Systems/1' | \
  jq '.Oem.Hpe.AggregateHealthStatus'"
redfish_catalog.reason_for_change: iLO7 was suspected to have changed the AggregateHealthStatus structure. Also needed to confirm `FanRedundancy = "Redundant"` still applies on the EL140 chassis (8 fans, non-contiguous slots).
redfish_catalog.required_change: **No structural changes required.** Same URL, same OEM path, all expected attributes present and healthy. `FanRedundancy = "Redundant"` confirmed on EL140 Gen12. iLO7 adds two new fields not in iLO5/6: `Network.Status.Health` and `PowerSupplies.PowerSuppliesMismatch`. These can optionally be added as additional health checks. ---

redfish_catalog.name: bios
commands:
ssh vcpe-jumpserver "curl -gsk -u Administrator:XXXXXXXXXX -X PATCH \
  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Systems/1/bios/settings' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"Attributes\": {\"WorkloadProfile\": \"vRAN\"}}' \
  -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}'"
# HTTP:200 — {"MessageId":"iLO.2.39.SystemResetRequired"}

ssh vcpe-jumpserver "curl -gsk -u Administrator:XXXXXXXXXX -X POST \
  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Systems/1/Actions/ComputerSystem.Reset' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"ResetType\": \"ForceRestart\"}' \
  -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}'"
# HTTP:200 — {"MessageId":"Base.1.18.Success"}
# Reboot issued: 2026-06-04T03:35:53Z
# FinishedPost:  2026-06-04T03:41:41Z  (~5m48s total boot)

ssh vcpe-jumpserver "curl -gsk -u Administrator:XXXXXXXXXX -X GET \
  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Systems/1/bios/settings' | \
  jq '.Attributes | {WorkloadProfile: .WorkloadProfile, ProcessorConfigTDPLevel: .ProcessorConfigTDPLevel,
    LlcPrefetch: .LlcPrefetch, ProcHyperthreading: .ProcHyperthreading,
    ProcTurbo: .ProcTurbo, ProcVirtualization: .ProcVirtualization,
    Sriov: .Sriov, SubNumaClustering: .SubNumaClustering}'"
redfish_catalog.reason_for_change: Two validations needed: (1) `LlcPrefetch` was unconfirmed in the EL140 Gen12 BIOS registry (U77 v1.30); (2) confirm the expected BIOS state at time of Icinga check. **Factory default on HPE EL140 Gen12 with U77 v1.30 is `WorkloadProfile: vRAN`** — HPE configures this before shipping. A factory-fresh unit will already have `ProcessorConfigTDPLevel: Level2` and all 10 other vRAN tuning attributes applied. The bmc-config Ansible playbook re-confirms these settings but is **not a prerequisite** for the Icinga BIOS check to pass.
redfish_catalog.required_change: `LlcPrefetch` **exists** in the EL140 BIOS registry and returns `Disabled` — no change needed. All Icinga BIOS attributes confirmed correct at `/bios/settings` with `WorkloadProfile: vRAN` applied. `ProcessorConfigTDPLevel: Level2` is the live confirmed value — the Icinga check is correct as-is for EL140 once vRAN profile is active (factory default on U77 v1.30). **Note on `MinProcIdlePower`:** On EL140 Gen12 (iLO7), this attribute is `MinProcIdlePkgState` (renamed in the Gen12 BIOS registry). The vRAN profile sets it to `NoState`. If Icinga adds this check for EL140, use `MinProcIdlePkgState: NoState` not `MinProcIdlePower`. ---

redfish_catalog.name: fans

changes_required.change: Update plugin to accept Percent for iLO7

commands:
ssh vcpe-jumpserver "curl -gsk -u Administrator:XXXXXXXXXX -X GET \
  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Chassis/1/Thermal' | \
  jq '{fan_count: (.Fans | length), fans: [.Fans[] | {Name: .Name, Reading: .Reading,
    ReadingUnits: .ReadingUnits, Health: .Status.Health, State: .Status.State}]}'"
redfish_catalog.reason_for_change: EL140 Gen12 has 8 fans (not 6), and iLO7 reports fan speed in `ReadingUnits: "Percent"` instead of RPM. Fan slot numbering is also non-contiguous (Fan 1, 2, 9–14 — fans 3–8 not present).
redfish_catalog.required_change: **Critical:** If the Icinga plugin validates `Reading > 0` as a fan-spinning check, it should work (8 > 0 is true). If it validates `ReadingUnits == "RPM"`, that check will fail — update to accept `"Percent"` for iLO7 platforms. ---

redfish_catalog.name: thermal_sensors
commands:
ssh vcpe-jumpserver "curl -gsk -u Administrator:XXXXXXXXXX -X GET \
  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Chassis/1/Thermal' | \
  jq '{total_sensors: (.Temperatures | length),
    enabled: ([.Temperatures[] | select(.Status.State == \"Enabled\")] | length),
    absent: ([.Temperatures[] | select(.Status.State == \"Absent\")] | length)}'"
redfish_catalog.reason_for_change: EL140 Gen12 has a different thermal sensor count. Some sensors are present but in `State: Absent` (for unpopulated hardware like empty PCIe slots) — the count depends on whether Icinga checks total array members or only enabled sensors.
redfish_catalog.required_change: **Note:** The 6 absent sensors correspond to unpopulated PCIe slots, a second embedded NIC that is not installed, and the DPLL M.2 module thermal sensor (module present but sensor not exposed). These are expected hardware absences, not failures. ---

changes_required.change: Remove per-NIC health check; use AggregateHealthStatus.Network instead

commands:

  "https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Systems/1/NetworkInterfaces" | \
  python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin);
  print(json.dumps({\"count\": len(d[\"Members\"]),
    \"members\": [m[\"@odata.id\"] for m in d[\"Members\"]]}, indent=2))"'

ssh vcpe-jumpserver "curl -gsk -u Administrator:XXXXXXXXXX -X GET \
  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Systems/1/NetworkInterfaces/DE07A000' | \
  jq '{Id: .Id, Name: .Name, Health: .Status.Health, State: .Status.State}'"

ssh vcpe-jumpserver "curl -gsk -u Administrator:XXXXXXXXXX -X GET \
  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Systems/1/NetworkInterfaces/DE008000' | \
  jq '{Id: .Id, Name: .Name, Health: .Status.Health, State: .Status.State}'"
redfish_catalog.reason_for_change: EL140 Gen12 has 4 network interfaces (not 3), uses E830 and E825 adapters (not E810), and iLO7 returns `Status.Health: null` at the NetworkInterface resource level — a check for `Health: OK` at this level will fail.
redfish_catalog.required_change: **Critical — Health check must change:** `Status.Health` is **null** at the `NetworkInterface` resource level on iLO7. Do **not** check `Health: OK` per NIC at this endpoint — it will alarm on every EL140. Use `AggregateHealthStatus.Network.Status.Health: OK` from `/redfish/v1/Systems/1/` OEM data instead (validated in Section 2 above — returned `"OK"`). ---

print(json.dumps({\"psu_count\":len(psus),\"supplies\":psus},indent=2))"'
redfish_catalog.reason_for_change: Validation that count and health checks work identically on iLO7.
redfish_catalog.required_change: **No change required.** Same URL, same section, count = 2, both PSUs Health OK / State Enabled. Endpoint and check work identically on iLO7. Note: EL140 uses dual 3000W PSUs (P82622-B21) running at ~213–214V AC. The e930t used smaller PSUs — if Icinga checks `PowerCapacityWatts`, confirm the expected value matches 3000 for EL140. ---

redfish_catalog.reason_for_change: The HPE `PCISlots` endpoint and its `OperationalStatus.Status = InUse` structure **does not apply to EL140 Gen12**. changes_required.change: Update parser to access Manager[0]; update version value

commands:

  jq '.Oem.Hpe.Manager'"

  'https://[2607:f160:10:9249:ce:40a:0:e033]/redfish/v1/Managers/1' | \
  jq '{FirmwareVersion: .FirmwareVersion, ManagerType: .ManagerType, Health: .Status.Health}'"
redfish_catalog.reason_for_change: The OEM path `Oem.Hpe.Manager[].ManagerFirmwareVersion` at `/redfish/v1/` was valid on iLO5/6 but needed confirmation on iLO7. Also, the version value obviously differs between platforms.
redfish_catalog.required_change: The OEM path `Oem.Hpe.Manager[].ManagerFirmwareVersion` **works on iLO7** — no path change required. Note that on iLO7 `Oem.Hpe.Manager` returns an **array** (`[{...}]`) not an object — if the Icinga script accesses it as a direct object (`Manager.ManagerFirmwareVersion`), it must be updated to access index 0 (`Manager[0].ManagerFirmwareVersion`). Also note: `Managers/1.ManagerType` returns `"BMC"` on iLO7, not `"iLO 7"` as might be expected. ---
